issues.observed: HighwayMode contains enter_hwy, cruise, lane_change and FinishState; no highway_exit state is present in closed_model_inventory states or exact_source_inventory states under HighwayMode.
issues.reason: Derived containment from NL5 exit wording requires a highway_exit state inside HighwayMode; the closed model provides only FinishState for exit behavior.
issues.requirement_quote: In the cruise substate, if the distance to the front vehicle becomes less than 25 meters (`dist_to_front<25`) and there is an extra lane available, the system transitions to lane_change. The system can also exit the highway if the distance to the exit is less than 2 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<2`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Source NL mentions exit the highway and source inventory has transitions to FinishState on dist_to_exit<2, which could be interpreted as highway exit.
issues.title: HighwayMode does not contain highway_exit

issues.basis: NL5-ENDPOINT-CRUISE-EXIT contract, exact_source_inventory transition tr_0009, fcstm_model transition:line:30.
issues.expected: cruise can transition to highway_exit when dist_to_exit<2.
issues.observed: FCSTM transition line 30: cruise -> FinishState : /dist_to_exit_2, and source inventory tr_0009 targets AutonomousMode.HighwayMode.FinishState, no highway_exit target exists.
issues.reason: The required endpoint target highway_exit is absent; the closed model uses FinishState for the exit event, a wrong-target consequence.
issues.requirement_quote: In the cruise substate, if the distance to the front vehicle becomes less than 25 meters (`dist_to_front<25`) and there is an extra lane available, the system transitions to lane_change. The system can also exit the highway if the distance to the exit is less than 2 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<2`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: FinishState is the model’s highway exit sink and source NL refers to exiting the highway, so FinishState may serve as the exit target.
issues.title: cruise exit to highway_exit missing, model uses FinishState

issues.basis: NL4-ENDPOINT-LANE-EXIT contract, exact_source_inventory transition tr_0011, fcstm_model transition:line:32.
issues.expected: lane_change can transition to highway_exit when dist_to_exit<2.
issues.observed: FCSTM transition line 32: lane_change -> FinishState : /dist_to_exit_2, source inventory tr_0011 targets FinishState.
issues.reason: Required target highway_exit is not present; the model routes exit to FinishState, a target mismatch with behavioral consequence.
issues.requirement_quote: If the system is in lane_change, it can return to cruise once the lane change is completed or exit the highway if the distance to the exit is less than 2 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<2`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: FinishState is used as the highway exit sink in the model, matching the exit semantics.
issues.title: lane_change exit to highway_exit missing, model uses FinishState
